objective: Test whether replacing the V16 char+word n-gram text head with pretrained BGE semantic embeddings improves the announcement-title signal enough to turn the full-cross-section rank IC positive.
hypothesis_origin: V15/V16 showed announcement-title text carries real but weak marginal alpha (ungated +5.9pp excess, but negative IC). The V16 report lists pretrained embeddings as the next margin. This line upgrades representation while keeping everything else frozen.

model.text_head: per-horizon Ridge regression (alpha 1.0, seed 61+h) on embeddings
model.baseline: reuses the frozen V16 baseline (V13 two-stage + V10 global), 65 percent
model.targets: same 1/5/20 day event targets, fixed blend 0.45/0.35/0.20

gates.v18_excess_beats_v16_ungated: excess above the frozen V16 ungated +5.92pp
gates.v18_beat_v13_baseline: excess above the same-run V13 baseline
gates.v18_ic5_positive: rank IC5 turns positive (the decisive gate)

decision_rule.all_gates_passed: the embedding text head replaces the n-gram head as the preferred representation; still no execution and still requires shadow testing
decision_rule.any_gate_failed: decision stays keep_v6; the embedding result is recorded as retrospective evidence

honest_reporting: embeddings are computed on titles only, not full announcement bodies
2020-2025 is a retrospective window reused by V3-V17
historical evidence strongly suggests the IC5-positive gate will fail
